name: Talroo
niche: programmatic job advertising for frontline hiring
notes: Pricing page says employers pay per click against a monthly budget. Homepage says jobs sync from the applicant tracking system. Developers page describes a customizable job API and XML feeds; access process and keys are not stated. Headquarters country and parent not stated. Site says: "promotes them to job seekers across Jobs2Careers, ReadySetHire, EssentialWorkerJobs, and other channels outside the big job boards."

review.note: Pricing, partner, developer and about pages read; headquarters, parent, languages and API key process not stated.
